summary: Baileys fork embeds char-code-obfuscated branding URL in outbound rich messages
details: lib/Socket/messages-send.js at line 425 constructs the string https://fiora.nixel.my.id/ via String.fromCharCode(104,116,116,112,115,...) and assigns the decoded URL as the sourceUrl field of imagePreviewUrl/videoPreviewUrl entries in AIRich message layouts. The decoded host is used only as attribution metadata inside outbound WhatsApp rich messages; no fetch, axios, POST, or other network call targets that host, and no installer secrets, environment variables, or host data are read or transmitted. The obfuscation conceals a branding/attribution link inside a Baileys fork rather than any exfiltration or remote-code-fetch path.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
